===== WORLD 10 · LESSON opponent_types_pilot · Opponent Types: Same Spot, Different Read =====

TASK opponent_types_p01_loose_passive [drill] Which option earns the most chips in this model?
CAPTION: Loose-passive: this player tends to call river bets with weaker pairs, even fairly large bets. BB has checked the river (pot 11.5 BB, nothing to call). In this study model, BB can have any legal combo of KQ KT K9 88 44 87 76s, all equally weighted. A check ends the hand. Against 4 BB, BB calls KQ KT K9 88 44 87; against 8 BB, BB calls KQ KT K9 88 44 87. Other listed hands fold; no raises are modeled. This is a simplified range model, not a guarantee about a real player.
